findings.observation: footnote_number is typed and stored but not used to tie footnote_text and owner_callout to the same ordinal. The actual three registry entries are correct, but an entry with footnote3 and existing callout5 in owner10 can pass.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit footnote-number/body/callout consistency checking or a clearly documented independently-reviewed override, with tests for valid4/5 mapping, wrong ordinal, and correct body plus different existing callout. Do not infer validity solely because both snippets occur in one source hash.
